verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes webhooks, a REST API, and a CLI that can be scripted/cron'd to run financial operations autonomously (auto-invoicing, auto receipt-matching, auto-cashback), and docs explicitly mention running operations 'from a script or CI pipeline.' However, its AI-facing interface (MCP) is confirmed read-only (31 get/list tools, zero write actions), so an AI agent cannot itself autonomously initiate payments or invoices — only human-built API/CLI automations can, which is a significant caveat for true agentic autonomy.
